sloka: ततो निश्चित्य मथनम् योक्त्रम् कृत्वा च वासुकिम् ।मन्थानम् मन्दरम् कृत्वा ममन्थुर् अमित ओजसः ॥१-४५-१८॥
transliteration: tato niścitya mathanam yoktram kṛtvā ca vāsukim ।manthānam mandaram kṛtvā mamanthur amita ojasaḥ ॥1-45-18॥

translations.english: Thereupon, having decided to churn (the ocean mind) those very powerful ones, made Vasuki, (the great snake), as a rope and Mandara mountain as the churning rod.And started churning it.
